# Ship source and design provenance

<!-- markdownlint-disable MD024 MD033 -->

Generated from the same TOMLs as the game. Original designs are interpretations, not historical or authentic source geometry. MIT covers project-authored geometry; imported designs retain their listed terms and [original notices](../NOTICE.md). Dimensions may be estimates and are not SI docking-clearance measurements.

<a id="sh001"></a>

## SH001 - Mule

**Design:** Original project-authored hull; no imported mesh, coordinates or bitmap inputs; MIT.

Original detailed/native relative-unit source; unchanged coordinates, axes, origin, indices and appearance. Explicit per-ID uniform engineering scale is provenance, not edited geometry. Native qualification and actual game acceptance pending.

**Appearances:** L337; **evidence:** Current original R3 27c960f32df859e67b969e2d9a25d9fb15f8a887a253cd20f7cd213a728bf14c.

Imported numerical geometry and complete custody metadata are embedded in the TOML; original source files/notices remain separately attributable. Six zero-area source triangles across three assemblies are harmless and skipped by back-face projection.

Entire original detailed SH009 geometry, uniformly scaled by exact 30000000/3186991 metres per source unit under Root-adopted new 30 m detailed Z authoring target. ## SH038 - Vulture Mk II

**Design:** Original project-authored replacement design proposal; procedural geometry; MIT.

Original detailed/native relative-unit source; unchanged coordinates, axes, origin, indices and appearance. Explicit per-ID uniform engineering scale is provenance, not edited geometry. Native qualification and actual game acceptance pending.

**Appearances:** L337; **evidence:** Current original R3 55d9bb7a617e090e120ae639b19a6eb1f8fa91d220928bf58a498193c425ffd6.

Imported numerical geometry and complete custody metadata are embedded in the TOML; original source files/notices remain separately attributable. Six zero-area source triangles across three assemblies are harmless and skipped by back-face projection.
